notes: REF-BM-02: collects title/description/favicon but never a preview/og:image. REF-BM-03: title editable after save (edit dialog/title-editor) but description is never editable and there is no pre-save edit step. REF-BM-04: edit dialog covers url/title/notes/tags but omits description (update schema has no description field). REF-BM-06: duplicate is detected and blocked by default, but the dialog only offers 'keep existing' or 'save another copy' (allowing a duplicate) and never routes to editing the existing bookmark. REF-BM-10: tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete from existing tags. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax; query is whitespace-split into AND'd phrases over the FTS index. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: user quotes are stripped, so quoted exact-phrase matching is not supported. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later concept; only an is_favorite flag (a beyond-reference feature), so read-state marking, an unread-only view, and marking-as-read are absent. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions; all actions are per-card, and no filter-scoped bulk operation exists. REF-BM-22: list order is hard-coded to created_at DESC with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: markdown notes can be written/stored but are never rendered or even displayed when viewing, and no markdown renderer is present. REF-BM-24/25: no HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support of any kind. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (default sort, items-per-page, font size); font sizes are only static CSS.
